sections.text:
BioIntel Demo
Cardiology reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 2. The compound dofetilide was discussed with target KCNH2 in the context of cardiac arrhythmia. The example mutation is T618I. A demonstration Ki measurement of 171 nM is shown for Homo sapiens. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0002 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0002.
